key_insight: A shared graph neural representation links diverse acyclic AB block-copolymer architectures to RPA instability limits.
engineering_relevance: The approach could accelerate architecture screening for phase-behavior design and guide future self-consistent field theory exploration.
method: Represent each acyclic AB multiblock chain as a graph.
Train a GNN to predict RPA instability limits across chain topologies.
Test extrapolation to more blocks and transfer to instability-wavenumber prediction.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports reconstructed stability-limit curves, retained predictive capability for architectures with more blocks, and transfer to wavenumber prediction, but provides no numerical accuracy metrics.
watch_item: Validation is limited to acyclic AB architectures and RPA instability prediction; ordered-phase mapping remains a future application.
paper_title: Effective Graph Neural Representation of Chain Architectures of Block Copolymers Tested by Predicting RPA Instability Limits
